text: [150] 60 aṭṭhime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā .pe. anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa . katame aṭṭha sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno arahā arahattāya paṭipanno . ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā .pe. anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti . cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā esa saṅgho samukkaṭṭho sattānaṃ aṭṭha puggalā yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekkhānapāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ ettha dinnaṃ mahapphalanti . sandhānavaggo paṭhamo . tassuddānaṃ gotamī ovādaṃ saṅkhittaṃ dīghajāṇuñca 1 ujjayo bhayā deva āhuneyyā [ca] deva ca aṭṭhapuggalāti . ______________ cālavaggo dutiyo
